parsed.change_summary: Replaced SHA256 with Rfc2898DeriveBytes for password hashing.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger is blocked because Rfc2898DeriveBytes, which implements PBKDF2, is a much stronger algorithm for password hashing compared to SHA256. PBKDF2 is designed to be computationally intensive, which makes brute-force attacks more difficult and time-consuming.
parsed.behavior_changes: The behavior changes from using a simple hash function (SHA256) to a password-based key derivation function (PBKDF2). The output will be different and more secure for the same input.
